label: copy-phase input v early in the recall (sparse tail)
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (98% of mass) when the fed-back input is v, mostly at recall_idx 2 (v is original token 1, so it is input right after the copied first token; 69% of mass); weaker on input t (8%) and x. Never fires in the original phase, which includes original-phase v inputs. Very sparse: only about 2% of copy-phase v inputs at recall_idx<=3 activate it, so precision is low (~0.02) while recall/mass recall ~0.86. Activation is more frequent (precision rises to ~0.19) in short (L<=5), digit-free sequences whose output token is a late letter (s,t,u,v,w), e.g. m v t w <DEL> m [v] t. Top activations are of that form. It does not fire at recall_idx>=5 or on the delimiter.
